'''''Boggie Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] that were built by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After [[Ambush on Hashim|stealing]] ''[[Proto 11]]'', one of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] prototypes. Tarrak arranged a [[Battle of Yrrna|demonstration]] of the powerful fighters to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by destroying a cargo area in the [[Yrrna system/Legends|Yrrna system]]. Tarrack's TIE Defenders destroyed the [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] in the area. The surviving crew managed to escape on a [[Modular conveyor]] ''[[Ulzepdi]]'' with cover provided by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Avenger]].
